caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wall sconce or candelabra rendered primarily in shades of gold and brass tones. At the top, there is a wide, upward-curving, semi-circular band holding eight evenly spaced candle holders, all colored in gold. Below the band, a series of small, clear, teardrop-shaped glass or crystal pendants hang down in a regular pattern. The main structural support consists of seven vertically arranged, gold ornamental rods, each decorated with leaf-like detailing, radiating out from a central, ornate gold base at the bottom. The gold base has symmetric decorative flourishes with some curling elements. The design is centered within a light beige or off-white background, bordered by a simple, hand-drawn rectangular frame in light brown ink. There is a small, dotted, semi-circular line below the central base and a signature in the lower right corner outside the main drawing.
title: Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
